name: cavemio-combo-chart
title: Combo chart
description: Every day as a bar and the trend as a line on one scale: point at a day and the header becomes its readout while the line’s dot pings where it lands.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Grey in a new shadcn project? Its default theme sets --chart-1 to --chart-5 to greys. Set five colours, light and dark, as in Theming › Chart colours (/ui/theming#charts).
- One scale for both marks, by design: a second axis would make the line’s height mean something different from the bars’.
- The plot is one tab stop: arrow keys, Home and End move between days and the day’s count and average are announced.
- The legend draws a bar and a line key, so the two marks are told apart by shape as well as colour; every day is in a visually hidden table.
- Bars use --chart-1 and the line --chart-2 from your theme.
- Installs Number roll and Text morph. With reduced motion nothing grows or pings.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

useCases.title: Orders and sales
useCases.description: A bar for every day of sales, with the trend running over them.

useCases.title: Signups and traffic
useCases.description: Daily visitors with a 7-day average that smooths out the noise.

useCases.title: Support volume
useCases.description: Tickets per day, so a spike stands out against the usual level.

useCases.title: API and app usage
useCases.description: Daily requests or active users in a usage dashboard.

features.title: Bars and trend on one scale
features.description: Every day is a bar and the average is a line over them. There is only one axis, so the line never means something different.

features.title: The rolling average is built in
features.description: A 7-day average by default, or pass your own line values.

features.title: Point at a day
features.description: The header becomes the readout: that day’s title, total and average, rolling to the new numbers.

features.title: Best, average and quietest
features.description: Three tiles under the chart show the best day, the daily average and the quietest day.

features.title: Change since last period
features.description: Pass the previous total and a chip shows the change.

features.title: Keyboard and a hidden table
features.description: Arrow keys move between days, and every day is also in a visually hidden table.

states.title: arrive
states.description: In view for the first time, each bar grows from the baseline (640ms, 14ms apart) and the average is revealed from left to right after them (1100ms); every figure rolls up from zero.

states.title: hover
states.description: The bar under the pointer goes to full strength and the rest dim; the line’s dot glides to that day (260ms, slight overshoot) and a ring pings out from it once (640ms). The title morphs to "<title> on <day>", the total and average roll to the day and the change chip folds away until you leave.

states.title: tiles
states.description: Best day, daily average and quietest day, each with its date or span, roll up on arrival.
